Playbook.name: F5 WAF — Sustained Blocked Attack Campaign Against Banking Applications - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: One source generated a sustained campaign (>=300 in ~30 min) of rating>=4 attacks that the WAF BLOCKED. A blocked attack is still a real attack - this is the JCB pattern like source 152.70.180.122 (205k blocked high-rating hits/week) that no rule previously reported. Triage question: is the WAF holding, and did ANY request from this source slip through to the backend?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: A sustained campaign, even blocked, signals a determined adversary; if the WAF ever misses one request the impact is real. Confirming full containment is the goal.

Assets.AssetType: F5 BIG-IP ASM / Advanced WAF fronting JCB internet banking and public web apps
Published banking applications and their backend servers

LogSources.LogSource: F5 ASM CEF events via syslog -> logs-cef.log-* (observer.vendor F5)

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: F5 ASM logging to CEF over syslog, parsed into logs-cef.log-* (verified live).

CEF fields: deviceCustomString4=attack_type, deviceCustomNumber2=violation_rating (>=4 = real attack), deviceCustomString1=security policy, requestUrl, requestMethod, deviceCustomNumber1=HTTP response code, deviceCustomString6=source geo, cef.name=violation name, event.action=passed|alerted|blocked.

Signal.Name: Blocked campaign
Signal.Details: >=300 blocked rating>=4 attack events from one source in ~30 min.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Blocked-only from a single source is 'attack contained' - but the presence of ANY passed/alerted event for the same source flips priority to reached-target risk.

Investigation.Goal: Confirm the WAF blocked the whole campaign, or find the requests that were NOT blocked.

Step.name: Enforcement split - did anything slip past blocking
Step.Purpose: The decisive question: for this campaigning source, count passed/alerted vs blocked.
Step.Query: FROM logs-cef.log-* | WHERE observer.vendor == "F5" AND source.ip == "$source_ip" AND cef.extensions.deviceCustomNumber2 >= 4 AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS total = COUNT(*), blocked = COUNT(CASE(event.action == "blocked", 1, null)), passed = COUNT(CASE(event.action == "passed", 1, null)), alerted = COUNT(CASE(event.action == "alerted", 1, null)), types = VALUES(cef.extensions.deviceCustomString4), apps = VALUES(cef.extensions.deviceCustomString1) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: passed > 0 means some requests reached the backend despite the campaign - pivot to PB-F5-001/004 for those. blocked == total means fully contained.

Step.name: Campaign character and source geo
Step.Purpose: Understand the attack composition and whether it is the known high-volume campaign infrastructure.
Step.Query: FROM logs-cef.log-* | WHERE observer.vendor == "F5" AND source.ip == "$source_ip" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS events = COUNT(*), geo = VALUES(cef.extensions.deviceCustomString6), methods = VALUES(cef.extensions.requestMethod), sample_urls = VALUES(cef.extensions.requestUrl) BY cef.extensions.deviceCustomString4 | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 15
Step.AnalystNotes: Automated tooling shows a narrow set of attack types hammered repeatedly from one geo. Note the geo/ASN for blocklist and threat-intel correlation.

Node.Condition: INV-01 shows passed/alerted events > 0 for the campaigning source (WAF did not fully contain it).
Node.Result: True Positive (Campaign Partially Reached App - escalate, pivot to exploitation playbooks)

Node.Condition: INV-01 shows blocked == total (fully contained sustained attack from an external source).
Node.Result: True Positive (Attack Blocked - block source at perimeter, monitor)

Node.Condition: Source is an internal scanner/test generating blocked signatures by design.
Blocked campaign but source attribution/geo is ambiguous (e.g. CDN/proxy).

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-F5CAMP-SPLIT, INV-02-F5CAMP-CHAR to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: An approved scanner or test generating blocked signature traffic.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm the scan; exception the source; close as false_positive.

TruePositive.Definition: A determined attack campaign against the banking apps (blocked, or partially through).

Indicators.Item: Sustained high-rating attacks from one external source.

SOCAction.Item: Block the source at the perimeter/firewall (offload from the WAF).
If any passed: pivot to exploitation IR.
Add the source geo/ASN to threat intel and monitor for new IPs.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A benign automated client repeatedly tripping a signature the policy over-flags.

Indicators.Item: Internal automation hitting a fixed endpoint flagged as attack.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Block the source at the perimeter to offload the WAF.
If any request passed: escalate to exploitation IR.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Add source/ASN to blocklists and threat intel; monitor for campaign continuation from new IPs.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Perimeter-block persistent campaign sources; ensure enforcement (not transparent) on all public policies.

QualityChecks.Check: Threshold 300/30m from the measured campaign baseline (e.g. 152.70.180.122).
The value of this rule is catching WAF-absorbed campaigns that were previously invisible.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Source perimeter-blocked; no request reached the backend; intel recorded.
